usedFor: Each “New Estimate” in Autopilot is filed as a copy in Dropbox.

bestTemplate.name: “New Estimate” in Autopilot, then “Upload File to Dropbox” in Dropbox
bestTemplate.why: Estimates are the paperwork you most want backed up, and each lands in your chosen folder.

watchOut: “Upload File to Dropbox” needs a public link, and “Updated Estimate” can upload the same file twice.
